rationale: The Entry Motion sensor fails even when placed directly next to the base station after a reset, and its LED stays completely dark (no light or blink) when the reset/pair button is pressed. The customer reported dropping it on tiles while changing the battery, and it worked for a year before that. All other sensors on the same base station are online with normal RSSI, ruling out a system-level or signal fault; the dark LED indicates the device is not powering on, consistent with physical damage.

output.suspected_root_cause: Hardware fault suspected (L2) due to physical damage from the drop, likely affecting power circuitry or internal components.
